summary: FSI system demonstrates numerical stability. Results stabilized at 6.09 mm (Delta < 5% between 20/40 stations). 128% analytical gap is attributed to 2D continuum effects vs 1D Euler theory. Mesh safety validated.
limitations: Discrepancy with 1D theory (Euler-Bernoulli) remains significant (180%); suggest Timoshenko or 3D reference for higher fidelity.
